# Role Actions

Role actions allow the bot to manage the roles in your servers through various means, such as editing, deleting and creating new roles. These actions only pertain to roles and target users aside from managing a role.

{% hint style="info" %}
You must have the manage roles permission enabled in your server for your bot for these blocks to work.
{% endhint %}

| Block                                                                                                          | Information                                                                                                   |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [Add Roles](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/role-actions/add-role.md)                                      | This action allows the bot to add one or more roles to any server member.                                     |
| [Remove Roles](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/role-actions/remove-role.md)                                | This action allows the bot to remove one or more roles to any server member.                                  |
| [Add Roles to All Users](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/role-actions/add-roles-to-all-users.md)           | This action will add one or more roles to all users in the server.                                            |
| [Remove Roles from All Users](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/role-actions/remove-roles-from-all-users.md) | Use this to remove one or more roles from all server members.                                                 |
| [Create a role](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/role-actions/create-a-role.md)                             | This action allows you to create a role within your server.                                                   |
| [Delete a role](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/role-actions/delete-a-role.md)                             | Using this action, you can delete a role on your server.                                                      |
| [Edit Role](/custom-commands-and-events/actions/role-actions/edit-role.md)                                     | Using this action you can edit specific information (such as name, color or permissions) of an existing role. |
